setup.title: Setup
setup.view_only_description: You don't have permission to edit Setup.

languages.title: UI languages
languages.description: Choose which languages this agent supports. Enabled languages appear in the hosted-chat language switcher and get their own per-language fields in Info and Starters.
languages.min_required: At least one language is required.
languages.hint: To hide the visitor language switcher entirely, turn it off under Behavior.

toasts.chatlog_error: Could not save chat log settings
toasts.privacy_error: Could not save privacy policy link

settings.composer_description: Hide the file-upload or voice-input button if your agent shouldn't accept those inputs.
settings.file_uploads_help_1: Visitors can attach a PDF and ask questions about it.
settings.file_uploads_help_2: Each page counts as one message, on top of the normal message for the question. So a 10-page PDF costs 11 messages per question (1 + 10 pages). This is charged every time a question is asked while the PDF is in the chat.
settings.file_uploads_hint: Show the paperclip button so visitors can attach PDFs.
settings.voice_input_hint: Show the microphone button so visitors can dictate messages.
settings.chatlog_description: Store conversations so they show up in Chat Logs and feed analytics.
settings.store_conversations_help_1: When on, every chat is saved to your account so it appears in Chat Logs and feeds the analytics below.
settings.store_conversations_help_2: When off, nothing is saved on our side. The logged-in chatter can still see their own messages in the chat window during their session, but those messages aren't persisted — only that chatter can see them, and they're gone once the session ends.
settings.store_conversations_hint: When off, messages aren't saved — so the analytics below can't collect data either.
settings.analytics_description: Choose which conversation insights this agent collects. Turning one off stops the analysis and hides its dashboard.
settings.sentiment_help_1: After each chat, the model reads the conversation and labels the overall mood as positive, neutral, or negative.
settings.sentiment_help_2: The results roll up on the Sentiment dashboard so you can spot unhappy visitors and watch trends over time. Needs Store conversations on — there's nothing to analyze otherwise.
settings.sentiment_hint: Track whether visitors feel positive, neutral or negative.
settings.tone_help_1: Tone looks at how visitors express themselves — friendly, frustrated, curious, and more — rather than just positive or negative.
settings.tone_help_2: It's detected automatically after each chat and feeds the Tone dashboard, so you can see how people tend to approach your agent. Needs Store conversations on.
settings.tone_hint: Track the communication style — friendly, frustrated, curious and more.
settings.topics_help_1: Topics scans conversations and groups them by what people ask about, so you don't have to tag chats by hand.
settings.topics_help_2: New topics are detected automatically and rolled up on the Topics dashboard, showing you the most common themes. Needs Store conversations on.
settings.topics_hint: Automatically detect and group what visitors ask about.

setup.bubbles_description: Quick message prompts shown next to the widget launcher.
setup.bubbles_placeholder: e.g., How can I help you?
setup.bubbles_translate_empty: Add a bubble first to translate it.
setup.model_description: Tune how focused or creative your agent's answers are. Lower keeps replies precise and consistent; higher allows more variety.
setup.model_picker_description: The AI model this agent answers with. An admin chooses which models are on this list (admin panel → Settings → AI models).
setup.model_empty: No models yet. An admin adds them in the admin panel, under Settings → AI models.

behavior.hosted_description: Iframe options for the embedded Hosted Chat surface.
behavior.widget_description: Position, size, theme, and allowlisted sites for the floating widget.
behavior.bar_description: Keyboard trigger and on-page position of the launcher.
behavior.live_chat_hint: Let visitors hand off to a human. Works on the website widget only.
behavior.allowed_sites_help: Only these origins are allowed to load the widget.

domain.title: Custom Domain
domain.description: Serve this agent's Hosted Chat from your own domain instead of {target}.
domain.step1: Step 1 — Add a CNAME record at your DNS provider
domain.name: Name
domain.dns_hint: DNS changes can take up to 24 hours to propagate. Once it resolves, your visitors will see this agent's Hosted Chat on your domain.
domain.step2: Step 2 — Enter the domain you pointed at us
domain.hostname_hint: Enter the full hostname without scheme — e.g. chat.example.com.

api.title: JavaScript API
api.description: Control the chat widget programmatically using these methods and events
api.events_hint: Subscribe to widget events using window.chatvia.on(event, callback)
api.quick_example_text: Open the chat when a button is clicked:

sections.branding_color_hint: Click the color swatch to choose your primary color
sections.branding_avatar_hint: Upload an avatar for your agent (256x256px recommended)
sections.branding_logo_hint: Upload a logo for your agent (256x256px recommended)
sections.starters_description: Suggest questions to help users start conversations. Each can carry an optional icon.
sections.starters_placeholder_first: E.g., How can I track my order?
sections.starters_tip: Good starter messages are specific questions that showcase your agent's capabilities
sections.appearance_welcome_placeholder: Hi there! How can I help you today?
sections.appearance_privacy_url_hint: Shown to visitors as “By chatting, you agree to our privacy policy.” Leave empty to hide.
